title: Agent runway across repositories
goal: The owner sees how many agent hours can run before work reaches a block, and what unblocks the next layer
acceptance: A step is doable when it is agent work, not done, and every prerequisite is done or doable, transitively and across repositories

Blocks: an owner step, a step waiting on one, an unknown prerequisite, a cycle (reported once, never looped), an external wait; runway hours per backlog and for the solution, the first blocks reached and the owner hours that unblock the next layer
Fixtures: chain A (agent) → B (agent, other repository) → C (owner) counts A and B and reports C; a cycle; a missing prerequisite
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: A dependency the reader cannot resolve is a block, never assumed done

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Moved from F-095-T06 on 2026-11-24 when the owner split F-095. Implemented 2026-11-25 for 10.17.0; review, CI and tag remain. Closed 2026-11-25: released in v10.17.0 (#279; main CI green on e588cc3 confirmed before tagging).
